judgement.reason: HedgeDoc 2 runs as two separate application services, a backend and a frontend server built from different images and joined by a reverse proxy, and Deployz runs only one web service.

evidence.quote: HedgeDoc 2 will be split in two components. The backend and the frontend. Both are present in this repository.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker/docker-compose.yml defines 2 application services (backend, frontend). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: HedgeDoc 2 is split into a separate backend and a separate frontend image, and the production compose file runs both behind a proxy, so the selected backend Dockerfile alone does not serve the frontend.
